summary: Full backend + frontend testing of ListingCraft v1. Backend: 14/14 pytest passing (auth, listings CRUD, AI generate + regenerate title/tags, free-plan 402 quota on 4th gen, Stripe checkout returns URL, logout clears session, /auth/me 401 after logout, seeded demo has 3 pro listings). Frontend: Landing renders correctly with hero, pricing teaser, FAQ, footer. Demo login lands on /dashboard showing 'Hello, Demo.' with monthly usage card + 4 recent listings. Library page shows saved listings with search input and Copy/Duplicate/Delete controls. Generator flow succeeded end-to-end: AI produced a 100-score listing (title, 13 tags, 1278-char description, alt text, keywords) in ~25s, all copy/regen/Copy-All buttons present. Pricing page shows 3 tiers with monthly/annual toggle and all CTAs. Terms & Privacy pages render. No blocking bugs found.

issues: Browser tab title is 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be updated to 'ListingCraft' in /app/frontend/public/index.html for brand polish.
Text reads 'Built for Etsy sellers whod rather be making' — missing apostrophe/space in 'whod' (should be 'who\'d').

action_items: (polish) Fix landing hero pill typo: 'whod rather' -> 'who\'d rather'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~570 lines — acceptable for MVP but nearing the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting routers (auth/listings/payments) as it grows.

In listings_generate, on AI failure quota is decremented via $inc but library-cap check is placed AFTER quota increment — a user hitting library cap would still consume a quota increment. Consider moving _check_library_cap BEFORE _check_and_increment_quota.

Duplicate endpoint copies the exact same generated content and score — that consumes user-visible library space but no AI cost; fine, but the 'Copy — ' prefix on title may overflow the 140 Etsy title limit if original was already 135+ chars (currently truncated to 140 which is correct).
auth/me always writes usage counters to DB on every call (line 184-187) — an unnecessary write when nothing changed; wrap in conditional to reduce mongo load.
test_credentials: demo@listingcraft.app / demo1234 (pro plan) — from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, verified working.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_free_*@example.com users via /api/auth/register for quota testing; test_generate_and_regenerate cleans up its own listing via DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend tested at https://rank-your-listing.preview.emergentagent.com. All 12 requested review items verified passing. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_listingcraft.py covers health, auth (login/register/me/logout/dup/invalid), listings CRUD + AI generate + regenerate (title, tags), free-plan 402 quota, and Stripe checkout URL. AI generation ~15-25s; test uses 120s timeout. Demo account has ~4 listings now (3 seeded + 1 from generator UI test). Only cosmetic issues found (tab title, one typo).
